title: Plasma Arc Crystal Ball
description: A glowing glass plasma globe sits on a metallic base atop a table, with bright purple and cyan electrical arcs surging from a central electrode toward the inner surface. Inside the sphere, a cartoonish wide-eyed character with a surprised expression floats among stars and glowing particles, while dramatic lightning branches into a cosmic nebula background.
prompt: A surprised cartoon character with large eyes is trapped inside a glowing glass plasma globe on a metallic base. Bright purple and cyan electrical arcs and lightning bolts crackle from a central electrode to the glass surface. The sphere contains floating stars and glowing particles set against a dark cosmic nebula background, dramatic lighting, digital painting style.
